name: Logs
summary: The agent prints what it does (prompts, tool calls, errors) to stdout or a log file, and you read the logs when something goes wrong. There is no trace structure, cost tracking or evaluation, but also nothing to set up.
how: Log each model call, tool call and error with a timestamp
Include a run or session ID so lines can be grouped
Ship logs to your host's log viewer or a file
Grep or read logs when debugging
facts: None (stdout, files or your host's log viewer)
Zero setup, but hard to follow nested agent steps or compare runs
watchOut: Prompts and outputs in logs may contain sensitive data
No way to evaluate quality over time
